rationale: Approve: the candidate resolves all five sub-questions inside the advisory boundary, leaves the 1200-character ceiling parser-enforced and untouched, and its (e) reasoning is decisive — a decoder-level token clamp would trade a soft overshoot for mid-sentence truncation and invalid JSON, so prompt budget plus a validation-triggered reprompt is the right escalation. It also declines to overclaim V3/V4 causation. Caveat: the summary calls the 600 budget 'strictly lower' when it is lower than the ceiling, not the 500 target; tighten that wording before it is copied into packet prose.
